intent.title: [snoozap/1] Make Windows manual sleep control usable from the console
intent.responsibility: Deliver the first working vertical path in the empty repository: standard-user Windows foreground runtime, per-user singleton, handle-based SystemRequired backend and direct console awake/auto/allow-sleep/status/stop controls. Introduce only the shared model, Clock, platform/service interfaces and strict empty/version-1 configuration needed for this behavior. Power lifetime and requested-versus-accepted status are real, not fake scaffolding. No automatic probes, desktop, arbitrary scripts or network listener. This slice owns common composition primitives once; later slices extend them.
acceptance: A standard-user Windows console invocation can keep awake immediately with no setup; Auto/Allow sleep and exit release its own SystemRequired request.
Another owner cannot start even with a different data directory; display-off and normal locking work; rejected native request is visible.
The empty configuration creates no implicit rule; status/exit codes never imply protected work merely from selected mode.

display.summary: Usable Windows manual console control

intent.title: [snoozap/2] Keep Windows awake for application rules and timed controls
intent.responsibility: Extend the working console vertical path with real current-user Windows process and power-source probes, strict finite rules/configuration, serialized scheduler, unknown contributors, per-rule retained/startup holds, battery hysteresis and timed modes. Own shared engine policy and injected-clock tests once. User can apply a generic application rule and inspect its actual resulting native hold from CLI; this is not an engine-only scaffolding slice. Add Windows battery/lifecycle/process adapters needed by that behavior, including invalid edit preservation and resume reconciliation. No T3, HTTP, desktop or remote wake yet.
acceptance: A selected local application starts/stops an automatic hold through actual native Windows power control; power-source conditions and logical combinations work.
Nested ALL/ANY/NOT and mixed retain/release_after/startup policies pass fake-clock state tests and source failure/recovery acceptance.
Manual timed actions work with no probes or monitoring disabled; battery guard, replacement/expiry, resume and stale poll cancellation follow the approved contract.

display.summary: Application rules, battery and timed controls

intent.title: [snoozap/3] Save safe settings and explain activity and failures
intent.responsibility: Extend the working generic-rule console flow with complete strict config validation/atomic apply/export, bounded sanitized history/status diagnostics, Windows OS credential references and full native error/limitation reporting. Preserve prior valid state on rejected writes, distinguish battery absence from failed telemetry, and explain incomplete process access without reading other users. User can inspect why a hold is active/failed, clear/export safe history and verify credential storage denial has no plaintext fallback. Reuse power/process/policy foundations from earlier slices rather than rebuild them. No T3/HTTP login or graphical settings yet.
acceptance: Duplicate keys, unknown fields, invalid references/thresholds and incompatible versions preserve active config; interrupted atomic writes retain a valid old or new file.
CLI safe status/history/config exports distinguish activity/desired/accepted/limitations and never expose tokens, bodies, raw header/query values or machine-local bindings.
History limits/clear work; credential-store denial has no plaintext fallback; inaccessible matching process candidates report unknown.

display.summary: Safe settings, credentials and diagnostics

intent.title: [snoozap/4] Share one runtime through local IPC and CLI
intent.responsibility: Make the working Windows console runtime controllable by a second local CLI through current-user-only named pipes, bounded version-1 commands/snapshot subscription and all approved CLI verbs. Extract direct command handling behind Service so foreground owner and attached callers share behavior. Data-directory selection cannot bypass the singleton already owned by snoozap/1. Offline config check remains the sole owner-free command. Other commands attach and never silently start an engine. Shutdown releases holds/listeners. Native transport is an interface for later Unix ports. Wake verbs report unavailable until implemented.
acceptance: Concurrent starts and changed --data-dir cannot create two owners; other users and remote pipe clients are denied.
Version mismatch, slow/disconnected clients, oversized frames and unknown commands do not hang or mutate the engine.
CLI exit codes, JSON schemas, mode durations, monitoring, config apply/export, history and graceful stop match HLD; status success does not imply protected work.

display.summary: One per-user owner and local command interface

intent.title: [snoozap/5] Read authorized local T3 and WSL activity
intent.responsibility: Implement external read-only T3 MCP login, local environment registry, OS-stored credential refs, paging and supported activity filters. Validate endpoint identity/locality from Windows for both native and already-running local WSL environments. Include child agents across all projects; no thread content needed. Add fixed WSL current-user process checks with a running-state preflight before each inspection command. Skip execution and report unknown for stopped, missing or unreadable state. Accept the owner-approved stop-after-preflight restart race; disclose it during WSL application selection/settings and never automatically terminate a distribution. No user command templates, resident WSL helper or private COM dependency. Reuse shared observation/error/history contracts. First prove SDK OAuth plus Windows/WSL identity in a disposable test; a failure invalidating the selected integration returns to HLD before dependent work.
acceptance: A separately authorized Windows client signs in, observes local running/waiting/transitional/child work and excludes settled and remote-environment work.
Pagination cannot turn a truncated response into confirmed idle; revocation, expiry, timeout and schema failure yield sanitized unknown.

Native/WSL port collisions and multiple local environments fail safely or bind the verified intended endpoint; fixed process arguments cannot run user commands. Stopped/missing/unreadable preflight launches no inspection command and reports unknown. A controlled stop after running preflight may restart the selected distro; no automatic termination occurs and the setup/settings explanation discloses this accepted limitation.

intent.title: [snoozap/6] Add local HTTP and power conditions
intent.responsibility: Complete the built-in registry using existing process/T3 adapters, local-only typed HTTP GET and power-source conditions. Resolve and pin actual loopback addresses for each request; forbid redirects, proxy routing and URL userinfo. Fetch credential headers only from OS refs and sanitize errors before history. Implement JSON Pointer/scalar comparisons, absent-field semantics and bounded scheduling. No executable expressions/scripts or remote HTTP probes.

IPv4/IPv6 loopback works; DNS rebinding, redirects, proxies, nonlocal destinations and unsafe credential header values are rejected.
One request per probe is in flight; source failures and power conditions combine with real T3/process observations through the same engine.

intent.title: [snoozap/7] Expose direct Windows tray and status controls

intent.title: [snoozap/10] Discover and remember LAN targets and send WOL
intent.responsibility: Implement optional off-by-default target advertisement and host discovery/hold, selected physical-LAN association, bounded remembered registry, unpaired same-link wake-only listener, WOL send and matching-instance reachability checks. Persist remembered targets without evicting sleeping entries when 256 slots fill. Separate target-only from host hold. No remote local-control route, VPN broadcast, arbitrary destination or router/firmware changes. Shared network/wake code is owned here once; later ports only implement native interface selection/firewalls and acceptance.
acceptance: Awake-to-sleep targets remain remembered; wrong-network, interface replacement, full registry, malformed discovery and incompatible versions are truthful.
Unpaired selected-LAN clients can wake only a remembered same-network target; forwarded identity cannot grant local control/diagnostics.
Real supported Windows target wakes; send failure, packet sent, already reachable, reappearance and 60-second unconfirmed are distinct.

LAN browser cross-site/simple POSTs, missing/expired CSRF tokens, cross-origin token reads and forged Host fail before any packet; an unpaired native client obtains a bounded token through the existing GET and can explicitly wake.
